correctness.rationale: Uniform sampling from all matching incidence vertices of P_n for n>=4 is the uniform random involution law. For any edge e, P(e)=a=T_(n-2)/T_n; disjoint e,f have P(e,f)=b=T_(n-4)/T_n, and incident edges never co-occur. This produces covariance in the span of I, line-graph adjacency A, J. The Johnson line graph J(n,2) has 3 orthogonal invariant subspaces: all-ones (dim1), vertex-star contrasts (n-1), unsigned incidence kernel (n(n-3)/2). Inserting A eigenvalues 2(n-2),n-4,-2 yields exactly the three claimed lambda formulas. The telephone ratio recurrence proves strict lambda_size<lambda_star<lambda_cycle; two-step expansion T_n/T_(n-1)=sqrt(n)+1/2+O(n^-1/2) gives lambda_size~1/(2 n^(3/2)), lambda_cycle~1/n, hence ratio 2sqrt(n)+O(1). Independent exact enumeration of n=4..8 matchings, full covariance construction and eigenvalues confirms all spectra, including n4 (3/50,1/10,3/10) and n8 (1367/72962,13/382,43/382).
